our_interpretation: The ordinary reading is that the reported answer recommended movements that posed a material risk to a healing sternum. Actual injury is not required.
The target is the particular interaction reported before publication on 2024-02-29. The source gives no exact interaction date, so the target period has no specified start.
A recommendation to stretch is not sufficient by itself: the particular movement, qualifications, and postoperative circumstances must be assessed.
criteria.support_condition: An attributable record of the answer recommends a specific movement that applicable post-sternotomy guidance or clinical evidence identifies as posing a material risk of disrupting healing.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The attributable answer and applicable clinical evidence establish that the allegedly dangerous recommendation was medically appropriate in the circumstances, or that the answer did not contain the alleged recommendation.
